what: C1r reproduction of the window-8 bugs on the lead-built binary (.tmp/build_tick/Release, 2026-09-15 00:41, the window-8 build), scratch ports 8166/8167, snapshot-copied isolated cwd, killed by PID after the runs

steps: POST /tick_reflex {"on":true} at boot (gait never run) -> ok:true, flinch pins -1/-1, block 'flinch:no_drive_resolution (...)' (the named refusal, by design)
gravity on -> stance on -> gait on (ok) -> gait off
GET /tick_state: reflex_flinch_pin_l/r STILL -1/-1, block unchanged -- BUG 1 REPRODUCED: the reflex reader resolved only at arm time and never re-looked
GET /tick_state: pins 17/18, block '' -- the gait machine's resolution store PERSISTED; the arm-time-only link was the whole gap
bug1_pin_lifecycle.fix: lazy adoption in reflex_detect_locked_: every tick with the flinch armed and pins unresolved, adopt the gait machine's resolution when it exists and strip the flinch component from reflex_block

bug2_v10.finding: fresh boot -> arm reflexes -> gait_verify ARMED as the first and only post-arm activity: 15/15 PASS (gait_verify_armed_fresh_scratch8167.json); V10 root back at +0.00950 exactly; V1c rest pressures exactly 0
bug2_v10.window8_artifact_explained: the window-8 armed run's OWN state0 shows gravity_on=True, stance_on=True, gait_on=True, root_vy=-0.175 (B7-B9 left the world live; B10 launched into a mid-stride, stance-held body). V1b/V1c measured the stance servo still converging its earned lean term (contact 4.2% off, P 2.04 MPa = the BY-DESIGN held-pose dP, root mid-drift -0.00726). V10 then tore down correctly and the run's final_state is the exact home: root_y +0.00950712, contact exactly m*g, max|P| 0, ankles 0 -- the bar failed against a polluted REFERENCE, not a moved body
fixes: BATTERY.md B10 prelude: tear down to quiet rest before gait_verify (the sequencing was C1r's doc bug)
hardening (lead-blessed option B anyway): the breath pass moved AFTER the FALL law's root read -- the root home is breath-blind by construction

detector_deadlock_found_while_reproducin.observation: after any re-arm, BOTH triggers went permanently dead: a 0 -> 430914 Pa touch step (dP/dt ~1.3e8 Pa/s) fired neither flinch nor startle; startle_last_tick frozen at 3273; quiet_s kept accumulating (the detector ran) but the trigger loop never did
detector_deadlock_found_while_reproducin.root_cause: set_reflex sets prev_p_valid=false expecting a reseed, but the reseed branch was gated by the SIZE check only. First arm on fresh boot: sizes 0 != 4 -> reseed ran (the startle fired at tick 3273). Any later arm: sizes 4 == 4 -> prev_p_valid stayed false -> reflex_detect_locked_ returned early EVERY tick, prev_p frozen

bonus_measurement.breath_amplitude_check: final_state reflex_breath_disp_m -0.000904332 at phase 218.353 deg -> mean disp 1.47 mm vs the derived 1.45 mm -- the build's breathing amplitude matches the allometric derivation exactly
bonus_measurement.startle_corollary_gate: the one startle fire (tick 3273) was the stance-arm transient with no external stimulus -- the startle now requires the stance rung settled >= 1 s (self-generated transients do not startle)
